# Orbit Web Designs & Marketing

> Orbit Web Designs and Marketing is a Nairobi, Kenya web design company building mobile-first, M-Pesa-ready websites, SaaS apps, AI agents, dashboards and brand design for Kenyan businesses, live in 5-14 days from KES 28,999 via WhatsApp +254 741 992 308.

## Pricing — fixed, KES

- **Starter Website — KES 28,999:** 5 pages, mobile-first, basic SEO, WhatsApp + call buttons, copy polish, Analytics. Live in 5 days.
- **Business Website — KES 39,999:** 10 pages + blog, full SEO + schema, bookings/Calendly, copy all pages, <2s load. Live in 1 week.
- **Master Website — KES 49,999:** 15+ pages or full store, M-Pesa Till + Paybill + cards via Daraja, inventory sync, automations, training. Live in 2 weeks.
- **Orbit Care — KES 4,999 / 7,999 / 9,999 per month:** Starter 4,999 / Business 7,999 / Master 9,999. Hosting, SSL, backups, security, updates, WhatsApp support. Cancel anytime, site stays yours.
- **Custom SaaS App — from KES 49,999:** Auth, roles, dashboards, M-Pesa + cards, deployed + documented + training.
- **Graphic Design — from KES 14,999, brand kits KES 24,999:** Logos 14,999 (3 concepts), full kits 24,999 (logo + colors + fonts + social kit + guidelines). Source files yours.
- **Custom AI Agent — KES 49,999:** WhatsApp / site / email agent, trained on your business, qualifies leads + books jobs, 1 month tuning. AI API usage billed separately (few $/mo).
- **WhatsApp Responder — KES 27,999:** Greeting + away + quick replies, catalog + labels, click-to-chat, Meta setup. One-time.
- **Business Dashboard — KES 14,999 / 27,999:** Add-on 14,999 (plugs into your Orbit site) / Standalone 27,999 (own login, 3 sources, staff roles, CSV export). Live M-Pesa feed, bookings, stock.
- **Payment terms:** 50% to start, 50% on launch. M-Pesa, cards, PayPal, bank transfer. You own domain, files, M-Pesa credentials from day one.

## Facts

- Timelines: Starter 5 days, Business 1 week, Master 2 weeks — after photos/text/logo received, date in writing.
- M-Pesa: Daraja API access is free; Safaricom earns per-transaction. Till = counter/instant, Paybill = online/account-ref auto-match. Master 49,999 wires both + cards.
- M-Pesa limits: KES 250,000 per transaction, 500,000 per day, 500,000 max balance. Confirm tariffs live — Safaricom updates bands.
- Ownership: You own domain, content, files, M-Pesa shortcode from day one. Care cancel anytime.
- Contact fastest: WhatsApp +254 741 992 308, Mon–Sat 8:00–19:00 EAT.
